+# ALL VM PANEL - A TO Z COMPLETE FEATURES ANALYSIS
+### Har File Ka Full Breakdown (Choti se Choti Cheez Tak)
+
+> Ye report maine tumhare GitHub repo ke 19 ZIP + Google Drive ke 2 ZIP (Mpanel & Nobita-Cloud) ka deep code scan karke banayi hai. Har file ka naam upar hai aur uske niche uski A-Z information hai. Common features ek baar Common Section me likh diye hain taki repeat na ho.
+
+---
+
+## 🔁 COMMON FEATURES - Jo 80% Panels Me Hai
+
+Ye cheezein lagbhag sabhi VM panels me milti hain (HVM, NKVM, SVM, HKVM, VPanel-Pro, APanel, MPanel, etc):
+
+1. **VPS Lifecycle**: Create, Start, Stop, Restart, Delete, Reinstall
+2. **OS Templates**: Ubuntu 20.04/22.04/24.04, Debian 11/12/13, CentOS Stream 9/10, Rocky 8/9, AlmaLinux 8/9, Fedora, Kali
+3. **LXC ya KVM Virtualization**: Kuch LXC (HVM, SVM), Kuch KVM/QEMU (NKVM, HKVM, VPanel-Pro, APanel, AKVM)
+4. **Web Console / Terminal**: xterm.js + Socket.IO + paramiko / pty.fork() - browser se direct root shell, bina port 22 ke
+5. **File Manager**: Browse, Upload, Download, Edit, Delete, Zip/Unzip, Permissions
+6. **Live Stats**: CPU %, RAM MB, Disk GB, Uptime, Network RX/TX, Process count - har 2-5 sec me update via Socket.IO
+7. **Port Forwarding / NAT**: Auto port allocation (25501-25600), iptables, custom port forward, bulk port forward
+8. **Snapshots / Backups**: Create snapshot, Restore, Delete, Export .tar.gz, Auto snapshot schedule (daily/weekly) + retention
+9. **User System**: Register, Login, Logout, Forgot Password, Reset Token, Email verification, Profile edit
+10. **Admin vs User Role**: Admin sab dekh sakta hai, User sirf apna VPS
+11. **Multi-Node Support**: Multiple host nodes add karo, health check, circuit breaker, offline detection
+12. **Notifications**: Real-time notifications, unread count, mark read, clear all
+13. **Activity Logs / Audit**: Kaun kya kar raha hai, IP, timestamp
+14. **API Keys + REST API**: Bearer token se /api/v1/vps, /api/vps/:id/start, /api/nodes, /api/system/stats
+15. **2FA / TOTP**: Google Authenticator
+16. **Discord OAuth**: Discord se login, link, auto-register
+17. **IP Management**: Private NAT IP + Public IP display, IPConfig page
+18. **Suspend/Unsuspend**: Reason ke saath suspend
+19. **Resize/Upgrade**: CPU cores, RAM, Disk ko live badalna
+20. **Themes**: Dark mode, Arix theme v2.1.3, Nebula, Lucent, DezerX, Glassmorphism, blur, transparency
+21. **OS Icons**: Custom OS icons upload
+22. **License System**: License key activate, integrity check, HMAC-SHA256
+23. **Maintenance Mode**: Poori site ko maintenance me dalna
+24. **Email SMTP**: Forgot password mail, welcome mail
+25. **Database**: SQLite (hvm.db) ya MongoDB (vpanel-pro) ya MySQL
+
+---

+## 1. File: (Nissalop22)HVM-8.zip
+
+**Path**: `/tmp/panels/(Nissalop22)HVM-8/hvm/`  
+**Tech Stack**: Python 3.12 + Flask + Flask-Login + Flask-SocketIO + SQLite + paramiko + cryptography Fernet + Pillow  
+**Purpose**: Full LXC Container VPS Management - Hopingboz ka HVM Panel v8.0-PRO - sabse mature Python wala
+
+**A-Z Features**:
+- **LXC Management**: `lxc init`, `lxc start/stop/restart/delete`, `lxc exec`, `lxc config`, fallback image remote (ubuntu: + images:), `lxcfs` enable, mount cleanup
+- **OS Options**: 12 OS defined with min_disk, min_ram, family detection (apt vs dnf), pkg_install_cmd, sshd_unit_name
+- **VPS Create Flow**: user_id, node_id, container_name, ram, cpu, storage, os_value, password generate 24 chars, encrypted storage
+- **Installation Progress**: `vps_installing.html`, `vps_migrating`, `vps_reinstalling` - async install via `install_vps_async`
+- **File Manager**: `/vps/<id>/files`, browse POST, upload POST, SFTP via paramiko, `get_sftp_connection`
+- **Console**: `vps_console.html`, `console.html`, `node_console.html` - 3 backends: POSIX pty.fork(), Windows pywinpty, subprocess pipes fallback - zero creds root shell
+- **Live Stats**: `live_stats_manager.py`, `live-stats.js`, CPU/RAM/Disk/Network/Processes/Private IP, cache 5 sec, Socket.IO rooms `join_vps_room`, `subscribe_dashboard_stats`
+- **Port System**: `port_allocations`, `port_forwards` tables, `allocate_ports`, `create_port_forward`, `create_bulk_port_forwards`, `recreate_port_forwards`, host port hit counter
+- **Snapshots**: `vps_snapshots` table, create/restore/delete/export, schedule table `snapshot_schedules` with frequency, retention, next_run calc
+- **IP System**: `get_node_display_ip`, `get_node_all_ips`, `get_vps_display_ip`, `format_ip_for_display`, alias IP support
+- **Nodes**: `nodes` table (name, ip, ssh_user, ssh_pass encrypted via Fernet key derived from SECRET_KEY, status, cpu/ram/disk), `get_nodes`, `get_healthy_nodes`, circuit breaker `is_node_circuit_open`, `record_node_failure`, `get_host_stats`
+- **Users**: `users` table (username, email, password_hash, is_admin, discord_id, avatar, api_key, totp_secret, allocation, used_ports), main_admin_required decorator
+- **2FA**: `/2fa` route, TOTP verify
+- **Discord**: `/auth/discord/login`, `/auth/discord/register`, `/auth/discord/callback`, auto-register, link/unlink
+- **Email**: `send_email`, forgot_password, reset_token table, cleanup_expired_reset_tokens
+- **Notifications**: `notifications` table (type, title, message, data json, read, expires), unread count, mark read
+- **Logs**: `activity_logs` table
+- **License**: `license` table, `is_license_activated`, `activate_license`, `license_client.py`, integrity check `_enforce_license_module_integrity`
+- **OS Icons**: `os_icons` table, `/admin/os-icons`, upload/delete, `/os-icons/<os_name>` serve
+- **API**: `api.py` Blueprint `/api/v1/` - list VPS, start/stop/restart, delete, list nodes, system info, stats, suspend/unsuspend, resize
+- **Templates**: 40+ HTML: dashboard with gradient cards, hero welcome, stats-grid, premium-stat-card, vps_list, vps_detail (overview, console, files, snapshots, ipconfig, ports), admin dashboard, nodes, users, settings, logs, api, backup_list, live_stats, system_info
+- **Security**: Fernet encrypt node SSH password, strong VPS password generator, proxy fix, secure_filename, HMAC
+- **Backups**: `backups` table, auto backup interval 3600 sec, static/exports, static/uploads/profiles, os_icons, settings, snapshots/hosting_template.tar.gz
+- **Extra**: Profile picture upload/delete, api-key regenerate, preferences, health check page, maintenance.html, suspended.html, 403/404/500 errors
+
+**DB Tables**: users, notifications, nodes, vps, settings, port_allocations, port_forwards, sessions, activity_logs, license, backups, vps_snapshots, snapshot_schedules, os_icons, api_keys, password_reset_tokens, vps_metrics
+
+**Website Me Kaise Add Kare**: Python Flask app hai - `hvm.py` ko `HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=5000` pe run karo, `requirements.txt` install, `SECRET_KEY` env set. Frontend ke liye `templates/` ko apni site me embed kar sakte ho ya API se connect karke React me use karo.
+

+## FINAL RECOMMENDATION - Apni Website Me Kaise Add Kare?
+
+### Agar Tumhe Full VPS Hosting Business Banana Hai:
+
+1. **Backend Panel**: `vpanel-pro-main.zip` (Sabse modern, Arix theme, MongoDB, QEMU KVM, multi-node, telemetry charts, command palette) - Isko main panel banao
+2. **Alternative Lightweight KVM**: `apanel-main.zip` (AKVM) - Public IP pool feature unique hai
+3. **LXC Cheap VPS**: `(Nissalop22)HVM-8.zip` - LXC containers, low resource, high density
+4. **Minecraft Hosting**: `(Nissalop22)Hex-Mc-main.zip` + `Mpanel-main.zip` - MC servers ke liye
+5. **Frontend Website**: `hosting-website-main.zip` (Nova template) - Isko apni main site banao, JSON se content edit, multi-lang, currency, admin panel se pricing change
+6. **Full Business Suite**: `nobitahost-wab-main.zip` - Plans, billing, coupons, Cloudflare, blog, docs, CasaOS style - Isko hosting-website ke saath merge kar sakte ho
+7. **Security Layer**: `(Nissalop22)NR-PROTECTION-V1.0.zip` - DDoS protection middleware
+8. **Desktop RDP**: `XRDP-main.zip` - Users ko GUI desktop dena ho to
+9. **Theme**: `Thame-main.zip` - Agar Pterodactyl use kar rahe ho to
+
+### Common Integration Steps:
+- **API se Connect**: Har panel ka REST API hai - apni Next.js website se fetch karo
+- **Database**: SQLite se MongoDB me migrate karna ho to `vpanel-pro` ka Mongo use karo
+- **Auth**: JWT + Discord OAuth common hai - ek hi auth system banao
+- **Theme**: Arix theme v2.1.3 sabse best hai - iska CSS (`arix.css`, `pterodactyl.css`, `terminal.css`) apni site me copy karo
+- **Live Stats**: Socket.IO ka use karo - `live-stats.js` + `panel.js` me example hai
+- **File Manager**: `filemanager.js` + `xterm.js` + `addon-fit` common hai
+
+### Jo Cheez Common Hai Sab Me (Ek Baar Likhna Kaafi):
+- VPS create/start/stop/restart/delete/reinstall, OS templates, file manager, console, live stats, port forwarding, snapshots, user/admin, multi-node, notifications, activity logs, API keys, 2FA, Discord login, IP management, suspend/resize, themes, OS icons, license, maintenance, email
+

+# ULTRA DETAILED KHOKHLA ANALYSIS - A TO Z HAR CHEEZ
+
+> Ye report har panel ka andar tak khol ke banayi gayi hai. Har file ka tree, dependencies, DB tables columns ke saath, saare routes methods ke saath, saare templates, services ke functions, env keys, OS templates, README tak. Isko padh ke koi bhi naya website bana sakta hai.

+## COMMON ARCHITECTURE JO SAB ME HAI (Deep)
+
+
+### 1. Authentication Flow (Detail)
+- Register: username, email, password hash (werkzeug / bcrypt), email verification optional
+- Login: session + JWT, remember me, rate limiting
+- 2FA: TOTP secret generate, QR code, verify 6-digit code, backup codes
+- Discord OAuth: client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri, scope identify email, state token, callback creates user if not exists, link existing account
+- Forgot: generate token (secrets.token_urlsafe), store in password_reset_tokens with expiry 1 hour, send SMTP mail, cleanup expired via cron
+- Profile: edit username/email, upload avatar (Pillow resize 256x256), delete avatar, regenerate API key (64 chars)
+
+### 2. VPS Lifecycle Deep
+- Create: admin selects node (health check), checks node capacity (current_vps_count < max), generates container_name (vps-{id} or user prefix), generates strong password 24 chars (secrets.choice), stores encrypted (Fernet or bcrypt), calls lxc_init_with_fallback (try primary image, if 404 try fallback), sets config (cpu, ram, disk, network), starts container, updates status installing -> running
+- Start/Stop/Restart: execute_lxc or execute_host_shell via SSH to node, run_sync wrapper for async
+- Delete: stop --force, delete --force, deallocate ports, delete DB row, cleanup mounts, clean df output
+- Reinstall: delete container but keep DB, re-init with new OS
+- Suspend: stop container, set suspended=1, suspended_reason, status stopped, notify user
+- Resize: update DB cpu/ram/disk, apply lxc config (lxc config set limits.cpu, limits.memory), for disk: qemu-img resize or lxc storage
+
+### 3. Node Management Deep
+- Table nodes: id, name, ip, ssh_port, ssh_user, ssh_pass_encrypted, location, status, cpu_total, ram_total, disk_total, current_vps_count, max_vps, daemon_port, created_at
+- Add Node: encrypt password via _node_cred_key() derived from SECRET_KEY sha256 base64, test SSH connection, get host stats (cpu, ram, disk via psutil or df)
+- Health: get_node_status, get_host_stats, circuit breaker (failure count, 5 failures -> open circuit 5 min, skip stats), mark_node_offline, log_node_health_summary
+- Stats Cache: get_cached_vps_stats, cache_vps_stats with expiry 10 sec, cleanup_expired_cache
+
+### 4. Port Forwarding Deep
+- Tables: port_allocations (user_id, allocated, used), port_forwards (id, user_id, container_name, node_id, vps_port, host_port, protocol, created_at, hit_count)
+- Allocation: get_user_allocation, get_user_used_ports, allocate_ports, deallocate_ports
+- Create: get_available_host_port (scan 25501-25600, check if free via socket connect), create_port_forward (iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport host_port -j DNAT --to container_ip:vps_port), store in DB
+- Bulk: create_bulk_port_forwards (range vps_port_start to vps_port_end, host_port_start auto), bulk_range_id for grouping
+- Remove: iptables -D, remove_port_forward, remove_bulk_port_forwards
+- Recreate: on container restart, recreate_port_forwards (re-apply iptables)
+- Hit Counter: update_port_forward_hit on each connection
+
+### 5. File Manager Deep
+- Backend: get_sftp_connection via paramiko, or agent via HTTP, or direct lxc exec
+- Browse: POST /vps/<id>/files/browse with path, list files (name, size, type, perms, modified), sort
+- Upload: multipart, secure_filename, save to container via SFTP or lxc file push
+- Download: send_file or stream
+- Edit: read file, Monaco editor frontend, save
+- Zip: tar.gz create
+- Permissions: chmod, chown
+
+### 6. Console Deep
+- Frontend: xterm.js + xterm-addon-fit + Socket.IO
+- Backend: NodeShellSession class
+  - POSIX: pty.fork(), select, fcntl, termios, struct, read_chunk, write, resize
+  - Windows: winpty ConPTY
+  - Fallback: subprocess.Popen pipes
+- Flow: user joins room join_vps_room, server spawns shell, emits output via socket, client sends input via console_input event, resize via console_resize
+- Multi-session: 24/7 background persistence (vpanel-pro), session stored in memory, reconnect
+
+### 7. Live Stats Deep
+- Backend: get_container_stats (CPU via /sys/fs/cgroup/cpuacct, RAM via memory.usage, Disk via df, Network via /proc/net/dev, Uptime via lxc info, Processes via ps, Private IP via lxc list)
+- Cache: 5 sec, skip if circuit open
+- Frontend: live-stats.js, fetch /api/vps/:id/stats every 2.5 sec, update DOM, Chart.js area charts
+- Socket.IO: subscribe_dashboard_stats, subscribe_node_stats, request_vps_stats
+
+### 8. Snapshots Deep
+- Table vps_snapshots: id, vps_id, snapshot_name, description, size, created_at, node_id
+- Create: lxc snapshot container snapshot_name, calculate size, store
+- Restore: lxc restore container snapshot_name, restart
+- Delete: lxc delete snapshot
+- Export: lxc export snapshot to tar.gz in static/exports, send_file
+- Schedule: snapshot_schedules table (vps_id, enabled, frequency daily/weekly/monthly, retention_count, next_run, last_run), calculate_next_run, cleanup_old_snapshots (keep N latest)
+
+### 9. Database Deep
+- SQLite: hvm.db, WAL mode, backups folder with timestamped .db files
+- MongoDB: vpanel-pro uses mongoose, models: User, Node, VM, Activity, etc
+- MySQL: some panels support via config
+
+### 10. License Deep
+- Table license: id, license_key_hash, activated_at, activated_by, install_id
+- Generate: install_id = uuid, key = HMAC-SHA256(install_id, secret)
+- Activate: POST /activate-license, verify hash, set activated, integrity check _enforce_license_module_integrity (check file hash)
+- Revocation: periodic check to remote server
+
+### 11. API Deep
+- Auth: Bearer token via Authorization header, api_key_required decorator, check api_keys table, is_admin flag
+- Endpoints: 
+  - GET /api/v1/user/vms, POST /api/v1/user/vms/:id/start|stop|restart
+  - GET /api/v1/admin/vms, POST /api/v1/admin/vms, DELETE /api/v1/admin/vms/:id
+  - GET /api/nodes, GET /api/nodes/:id
+  - GET /api/system/info (hostname, platform, python version, cpu cores+usage, memory, disk, uptime)
+  - GET /api/system/stats (total_users, total_vps, running_vps, total_nodes)
+  - POST /api/vps/:id/suspend|unsuspend|resize
+- Rate Limiting: rateLimiters middleware
+
+### 12. Themes Deep
+- CSS variables: --panel-blur, --panel-transparency, --gradient-primary, --glow-primary
+- Arix theme: glassmorphism, backdrop-filter blur, glowing borders, ambient backgrounds
+- Wallpaper: 4K wallpapers API /api/wallpapers?category=all, categories Anime, Space, AMOLED, Cyberpunk, Nature, video .mp4/.webm
+- Music: copy.mp3, offline.mp3, online.mp3
+- Command Palette: Ctrl+K, spotlight modal, search servers, navigation, power actions
+

+### 📖 README (first 10k chars)
+
+```
+
+# Hex-Mc Panel 🚀
+
+Welcome to **Hex-Mc Panel**, a game server management & container orchestration platform built for Minecraft and generic game servers.
+
+The panel requires **Node.js 22.5+** because it uses Node's embedded `node:sqlite` engine without a native database addon.
+
+**Created & Maintained by Michael**  
+**Version:** `v1.0`
+
+---
+
+## ✨ Features
+- ⚡ **Dual Runtime Modes**: Run servers natively via host processes or isolated Docker containers (`itzg/minecraft-server`, generic node/python images).
+- ☕ **Multi-Version Java Engine**: Built-in support for Java 8, 11, 16, 17, and 21 with automatic version detection.
+- 🛡️ **Enhanced Security & Safeguards**:
+  - Strict 32+ char `JWT_SECRET` requirement in production environments.
+  - IP-based rate limiting on authentication routes to prevent brute-force attacks.
+  - Granular RBAC enforcing owner assignment privileges exclusively to administrators.
+  - Least-privilege POSIX file modes across server files, folders, and archives (anti-`0o777`).
+  - Pre-flight `DataVersion` world corruption safety check with admin-gated bypass.
+  - Configurable Socket.IO and Express CORS origin allowlisting via `ALLOWED_ORIGINS`.
+  - 2GB upload protection with HTTP 413 error handling to prevent disk-fill DoS.
+- 📡 **Telemetry & Nodes**: Live CPU, RAM, and Disk telemetry graphs with Hex-Mc Node Daemon / Pterodactyl Wings support.
+- 🛰️ **Hex-Mc Node Daemon**: Run `npm run node-daemon -- --config /etc/hex-mc/node.conf` on a Docker host. Add the node in the admin panel with its FQDN, daemon API port, SFTP port, and bearer token; the panel generates a paste-ready configuration and automatically creates a reusable allocation pool.
+- 🌐 **Built-in Playit.gg Tunnels**: Allocate public IPs and custom hostnames without opening router ports.
+- 💻 **Real-Time Web Terminal**: WebSocket console stream with color-coded log parsing and live command execution.
+- 📁 **Complete File Manager**: Web-based file explorer, syntax-highlighted code editor, chunked uploads, zip/unzip, and SFTP support.
+- 🧭 **Nebula-style server menus**: Direct Plugins and Mods installers plus functional Schedules, Databases, Allocations, Activity, and Docker Mounts modules—without a duplicate MCPlugins hub.
+- 🗃️ **SQLite server data**: Persistent feature records with encrypted database passwords and authenticated server-scoped APIs.
+- 🔄 **One-Click Updates**: Automated background self-updating script (`update.sh`).
+- 🔐 **GitHub and Discord OAuth**: Optional server-side OAuth login with one-time state and exchange codes; provider secrets never reach the browser.
+- 🧩 **Pterodactyl-style APIs**: Bearer API keys, scoped `/api/client/*` user endpoints, and admin-only `/api/application/*` management endpoints.
+
+---
+
+## 🛰️ Node daemon
+
+A node is added from **Admin → Nodes**. Use a public FQDN, keep the daemon API and SFTP ports distinct, create a strong bearer token, and copy the generated configuration to the node host. The daemon needs access to Docker and listens on the configured API port:
+
+```bash
+npm run node-daemon -- --config /etc/hex-mc/node.conf
+```
+
+The production build now ships a standalone `dist/node-daemon.cjs` bundle, and the installer registers it as a PM2 service:
+
+- Run `bash install.sh` and choose **Install Node Daemon** (or answer **y** during a production install) to generate a hardened `node.conf`, register the `hex-mc-node` service, and print the FQDN / API port / SFTP port / token to enter when adding the node in the panel.
+- `bash update.sh` rebuilds the daemon bundle and restarts the `hex-mc-node` service when it is installed.
+- `bash uninstall.sh` stops and removes the daemon service as well.
+- Manual install on a separate Docker host: `npm run node-daemon -- --config /etc/hex-mc/node.conf`
+
+Allocations are panel-owned SQLite records. The panel offers only free allocations during deployment and claims them atomically, so concurrent server creation cannot reuse the same port. Allocation ranges and assignments are never written to the node configuration: adding, removing, or changing an allocation requires no daemon-config update or restart. Keep the generated configuration private because it contains the node token.
+
+---
+
+## External API
+
+Use an API key with `Authorization: Bearer hexmc-...` or `X-API-Key`. Client keys are limited to their owner and may use scopes such as `account.read`, `server.read`, `server.power`, and `server.command`. Administrator application keys can use `user.read`, `user.write`, `server.read`, `server.write`, `node.read`, `allocation.read`, and `allocation.write`.
+
+Examples:
+
+```bash
+curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $HEXMC_API_KEY" https://panel.example.com/api/client/account
+curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $HEXMC_API_KEY" https://panel.example.com/api/client/servers
+curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $HEXMC_ADMIN_KEY" https://panel.example.com/api/application/users
+```
+
+Responses use Pterodactyl-style `object`, `attributes`, `data`, and `meta.pagination` fields. API keys are shown only once when created.
+
+Full endpoint tables, OpenAPI, scope definitions, and security guidance are available in [`docs/API.md`](./docs/API.md) and [`docs/openapi.yaml`](./docs/openapi.yaml).
+
+Additional client endpoints include `GET /api/client/servers/:id/resources`, `GET /api/client/servers/:id/console`, `GET /api/client/servers/:id/files?path=/`, and read-only server modules for `/schedules`, `/databases`, `/allocations`, `/activity`, and `/mounts`. Application administrators can also `GET`, `PATCH`, and `DELETE` individual users, servers, and allocations. Use `server.read` for client read operations, `server.write` for application server changes, `user.write` for application user changes, and `allocation.write` for allocation changes.
+
+---
+
+## 📦 Quick Installation
+
+Run the automated installer on your VPS / Linux machine:
+```bash
+bash install.sh
+```
+This opens an interactive menu that sets up all dependencies (Node.js, Docker, Java runtimes, firewall rules) and creates your initial Administrator credentials.

+### 📖 README (first 10k chars)
+
+```
+
+<div align="center">
+
+# ⚡ Nkvm v1.0
+### Next-Gen QEMU/KVM Virtual Machine Management Web Panel
+
+[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-v18+-339933?style=for-the-badge&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org)
+[![Express](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=express&logoColor=white)](https://expressjs.com)
+[![QEMU](https://img.shields.io/badge/QEMU-Virtualization-FF6600?style=for-the-badge&logo=qemu&logoColor=white)](https://www.qemu.org/)
+[![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/better--sqlite3-003B57?style=for-the-badge&logo=sqlite&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/WiseLibs/better-sqlite3)
+
+*A high-performance, dark glassmorphic web control panel designed for hosting, managing, and automating QEMU virtual servers.*
+
+---
+
+</div>
+
+## 🌟 Highlights & Key Features
+
+### 🎨 1. Cosmic Glassmorphism UI & Studio
+- **Deep Slate Dark Design**: Modern translucent glass cards with glowing accent halo borders (`--panel-blur`, `--panel-transparency`).
+- **Integrated 4K Wallpaper Browser**: Browse, search, preview, favorite, and 1-click apply high-res 4K wallpapers directly from [4kwallpapers.com](https://4kwallpapers.com/) across 15+ categories (*Anime, Space, Dark/AMOLED, Nature, Supercars, Gaming, Abstract, etc.*).
+- **Interactive Sliders**: Real-time CSS Backdrop Blur (0px – 40px) and UI Transparency (0% – 100%) controls without page reloads.
+- **Custom Media Backgrounds**: Upload local images or looping video backgrounds (`.mp4`, `.webm`).
+
+### ⚡ 2. Intuitive VM Creation Wizard
+- **⚡ Hardware Sizing Presets**: 1-click quick presets (*Starter, Standard, Compute/Dev, Powerhouse*).
+- **Dual-Control Resource Sliders**: Real-time synchronized range sliders and inputs for vCPUs and RAM.
+- **Filterable Distro Grid**: Cloud-image support for **Ubuntu** (22.04, 24.04), **Debian** (11, 12, 13), **Fedora** (40), **CentOS Stream**, **AlmaLinux**, and **Rocky Linux**.
+- **Live Deployment Blueprint**: Real-time sticky summary card updating specifications and cost calculations as you configure.
+
+### 💻 3. Next-Gen SSH Terminal & Serial Boot Logs
+- **Integrated Xterm.js Console**: Responsive web terminal connecting directly to guest instances over SSH.
+- **Kernel Boot & Startup Logs**: Dual-tab interface streaming live QEMU serial output, kernel messages, and cloud-init progress in real time.
+- **Toolbar Utilities**: Auto-refresh toggle (3s polling), auto-scroll, and 1-click clipboard copy.
+
+### 📁 4. High-Performance File Manager
+- **Guest Agent & SSH Dual-Engine**: Ultra-fast file operations with automatic graceful fallback.
+- **Accurate File Size Sizing**: Monospace human-readable formatting (`Bytes, KB, MB, GB`).
+- **Large Code Editor Modal**: Fullscreen multi-line editor (`width: min(1000px, 96vw)`) with monospace fonts and UTF-8 support.
+- **Multi-File Uploads**: Drag-and-drop or select multi-file uploads with payload support up to 200MB+.
+
+### 🛡️ 5. Multi-User & Enterprise Security
+- **Role-Based Access Control**: Root Administrators and Standard Users.
+- **Subuser Delegation**: Assign granular per-server permissions (*Console, File Manager, Backups, Power Controls*).
+- **Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**: TOTP authenticator app support (Google Authenticator, Authy).
+- **Comprehensive Audit Logs**: Real-time event timeline logging all VM power actions, logins, and permission changes.
+
+### 💾 6. Snapshots & Cron Automation
+- **Instant Disk Backups**: 1-click snapshot creation, restoration, and raw disk download.
+- **Automated Scheduling**: Standard 5-field Cron automation for automatic backups, restarts, and routine maintenance.
+
+---
+
+## 🏗️ Architecture & Tech Stack
+
+```text
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│                       Nkvm UI                               │
+│   (Glassmorphism CSS • EJS Templates • Socket.IO • Xterm)   │
+└──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
+                               │ HTTP / WebSocket (Port 3001)
+┌──────────────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────┐
+│                    Node.js + Express Core                   │
+│  (Auth Middleware • SQLite/better-sqlite3 • VM Orchestrator)│
+└──────────────┬──────────────────────────────┬───────────────┘
+               │                              │
+┌──────────────▼──────────────┐┌──────────────▼───────────────┐
+│     QEMU Hypervisor Engine  ││     Nkvm Guest Agent         │
+│  (-drive, -smp, -m, -netdev)││  (Python HTTP Daemon / SSH)  │
+└─────────────────────────────┘└──────────────────────────────┘
+```
+

+## 📋 System Requirements
+
+- **Operating System**: Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian 11+, RHEL/CentOS 9+, Fedora, Arch Linux)
+- **Node.js**: v18.0.0 or higher (Node 20+ recommended)
+- **Hypervisor**: QEMU (`qemu-system-x86_64`, `qemu-img`)
+- **Utilities**: `cloud-image-utils` (`cloud-localds`), `wget`, `openssl`, `python3`

+## 🚀 Quick Start & Installation
+
+### Option 1: Automated Setup (Recommended)
+
+```bash
+# Clone the repository
+git clone https://github.com/StriderCraft315/Nkvm.git
+cd Nkvm
+
+# Run the automated installer
+sudo bash install.sh --admin-pass 'your_secure_password'
+```
+
+### Option 2: Manual Installation
+
+```bash
+# 1. Clone repository and install dependencies
+git clone https://github.com/StriderCraft315/Nkvm.git
+cd Nkvm
+npm install
+
+# 2. Build assets
+npm run build
+
+# 3. Create administrator account
+npm run createuser
+
+# 4. Start Nkvm
+npm start
+```
+
+### Production Deployment with PM2
+
+```bash
+# Start cluster process
+pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
+
+# Save process list for system reboot
+pm2 save
+pm2 startup
+```

+## 🌐 Default Ports & Access
+
+| Service | Default URL | Description |
+| :--- | :--- | :--- |
+| **Web Panel** | `http://<host_ip>:3001` | Main user dashboard and management interface |
+| **REST API** | `http://<host_ip>:3001/api` | RESTful API for automation & integrations |
+| **VM Port Range** | `25501 - 25600` | Dynamic host-forwarded SSH ports |
+| **Agent Port Range**| `26101 - 26200` | Internal guest-daemon communication |

+## 🔌 API Reference Overview
+
+| Method | Endpoint | Description |
+| :--- | :--- | :--- |
+| `POST` | `/api/login` | Authenticate and obtain JWT bearer token |
+| `GET` | `/api/vms` | List all accessible virtual machines |
+| `POST` | `/api/vms/:id/action` | Trigger power action (`start`, `stop`, `restart`, `kill`) |
+| `GET` | `/api/vms/:id/bootlog` | Stream kernel boot & serial output logs |
+| `GET` | `/api/vms/:id/files?path=/` | List files and directories in guest filesystem |
+| `GET` | `/api/vms/:id/files/download` | Download file from guest |
+| `POST` | `/api/vms/:id/files/upload` | Upload binary/text file to guest |
+| `GET` | `/api/wallpapers?category=all` | Browse 4K wallpaper library with search & pagination |
+| `POST` | `/api/wallpapers/apply` | 1-click apply wallpaper and glassmorphism styles |

+### 📖 README (first 10k chars)
+
+```
+
+ALTREX CODE V4 - GITHUB REPOSITORY PACK
+=======================================
+
+The folder ALTREX-CODE is a clean, ready-to-push repository:
+  - complete source code (no node_modules, no build output, no keys, no personal files)
+  - README.md for your subscribers
+  - .github/workflows/ci.yml: GitHub automatically runs typecheck, tests and build
+    on every push (Windows runner; no API keys needed)
+  - .gitignore already excludes node_modules, build output, release files and .env files
+
+
+Step 1 - Create the repository on GitHub
+----------------------------------------
+  On github.com: New repository -> name it (for example ALTREX-CODE)
+  -> choose Private or Public -> do NOT add a README, .gitignore or license
+  (the pack already has them) -> Create repository.
+
+
+Step 2 - Push the code (PowerShell or Git Bash)
+-----------------------------------------------
+    cd ALTREX-CODE
+    git init -b main
+    git config user.name  "Your Name"
+    git config user.email "you@example.com"
+    git add .
+    git commit -m "ALTREX CODE V4"
+    git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/YOUR-REPO.git
+    git push -u origin main
+
+  Replace YOUR-USERNAME / YOUR-REPO and your name/email with your own.
+  After the push, open the "Actions" tab to see the CI checks run.
+
+
+Step 3 - Publish the Windows app (optional)
+-------------------------------------------
+  Do not commit the .exe files into the repository (GitHub blocks files over 100 MB).
+  Instead: on GitHub open Releases -> "Draft a new release" -> tag v4.0.0
+  -> attach ALTREX-CODE-Setup-0.1.0-x64.exe, ALTREX-CODE-Portable-0.1.0-x64.exe and
+  SHA256SUMS.txt (they are in the Full Pack, folder Windows-App) -> Publish release.
+
+
+Before you publish
+------------------
+  - LICENSE: the pack has no license file. Without one, others may view the code but have
+    no permission to reuse it. If you want subscribers to be allowed to use or modify
+    it, add a LICENSE file of your choice (GitHub: Add file -> Create new file ->
+    name it LICENSE -> "Choose a license template").
+  - Never commit API keys or .env files. ALTREX stores keys encrypted on each user's
+    computer, so no key is ever needed in the repository.
+  - Delete this UPLOAD_TO_GITHUB.txt file after uploading (it is outside the repo folder).
+
+
+```

+### 📖 README (first 10k chars)
+
+```
+
+# MYRAA 1.5.2 — source code
+
+MYRAA is a 3D AI companion for Windows: she talks with you by voice (Google Gemini Live),
+can see your screen when you allow it, controls apps and files on your PC, and lives on your
+desktop as a character you can drag onto windows.
+
+This pack is the full source. If you just want to use MYRAA, install the setup .exe instead.
+
+## What is NOT included (on purpose)
+
+- **No API key.** You use your own free Gemini key from https://aistudio.google.com.
+- **No 3D character model.** The models used while developing MYRAA have licences that forbid
+  redistribution. Import your own MMD model (.pmx, or a .zip / folder containing one) in the app:
+  the first screen offers **Import my character**, or use Settings → Character → Character Studio.
+  Only use models whose licence allows your use.
+- No personal data, logs, memories or settings.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
+- Node.js 20 or newer (https://nodejs.org)
+- Python 3.11 (only to run or rebuild the desktop agent from source)
+
+## Run it in development
+
+```
+npm install
+pip install -r desktop_agent/requirements.txt
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Open http://localhost:3000 in Chrome. The first screen asks for your Gemini API key
+(stored encrypted with Windows DPAPI in your user data folder, never in the project).
+
+Desktop app (Electron, with the desktop companion):
+
+```
+npm run app
+```
+
+Optional: copy `.env.example` to `.env` for development settings. Do not put a real key in a file
+you share.
+
+## Build the installer
+
+1. Build the desktop agent (PyInstaller):
+   ```
+   pip install pyinstaller
+   pyinstaller desktop_agent.spec --distpath agent_dist --workpath agent_build
+   ```
+2. Build the public installer (no bundled character):
+   ```
+   npm run dist:public
+   ```
+   Output: `release-public/MYRAA-Setup-<version>.exe`
+
+`npm run dist` (electron-builder.yml) expects a character in `assets/characters/`, which is not
+included; use `dist:public`.
+
+## Project map
+
+| Folder | What it is |
+|---|---|
+| `src/` | React UI, the 3D character engine (three.js, MMD/PMX), desktop companion renderer |
+| `electron/` | Desktop shell: windows, tray, desktop companion brain, crash recovery |
+| `server.ts`, `runtime/` | Local backend (Express + WebSocket), Gemini Live bridge |
+| `agent/` | PC-control agent: planner, actions, WhatsApp/chat helpers, safety checks |
+| `desktop_agent/` | Python tool server (UI Automation, input, files, apps) |
+| `models/` | Model router (Gemini and others) |
+| `voice/` | Live voice tools |
+| `settings/`, `permissions/`, `secrets/` | Settings, permission engine, DPAPI key store |
+| `character_import/` | PMX importer and capability report |
+| `cognition/`, `memory/`, `presence/` | Memory, initiative and presence |
+
+## Graphics quality
+
+Settings → Character → Graphics quality: Auto, High, Medium, Optimized, Potato PC.
+Auto steps down by itself if the character crashes on a weak GPU.
+
+## Safety
+
+- The API key never reaches the web page; all Gemini calls go through the local backend.
+- High-risk actions (sending messages, deleting, installing, purchases) ask for confirmation.
+- Text from websites, documents and the screen is treated as untrusted data.
+- Stop everything any time with the emergency shortcut (default Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S).
+
+

+| **SFTP Server** | `3004` | Built-in SFTP (`sftp://host:3004`) |

+## 📌 About The Project
+
+ConvoyPanel's original template downloader (`downloader_x86`) broke when its default CDN endpoint (`images.cdn.convoypanel.com/images.json`) was deprecated, producing the error:
+
+```
+thread 'main' panicked at src/downloader.rs:38:10:
+Failed to parse images: reqwest::Error { kind: Decode, source: Error("expected value", line: 1, column: 1) }
+```
+
+This repository fixes that issue and provides **[`run.sh`](run.sh)** — a powerful, standalone, interactive Bash utility with:
+- **Interactive Checkbox Multi-Selection** (toggle with `Space`, navigate with Arrow keys, `a` for select all, `Enter` to confirm)
+- **Install Templates**: `Select All` or `Select Custom Multiple`
+- **Uninstall Templates**: `Select All` or `Select Custom Multiple`
+- **Automated Proxmox Restore**: Uses `qmrestore` + `qm template` with immediate temp-file cleanup
+- **Zero Dependencies**: Pure Bash script that runs natively on any Proxmox VE 7.x / 8.x host
+
+---
+

+
+```text
+  ╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
+  ║        ⚡ Convoy Proxmox OS Template Manager & Fix ⚡         ║
+  ╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
+  ● Proxmox VE Environment: Detected (Live Mode)
+
+Select an action:
+  [1] Install OS Templates      (Select All / Select Custom Multiple)

+## ⚙️ Detailed Menu Features
+
+### 1️⃣ Option 1: Install OS Templates
+- **Select All**: Downloads and restores all 16 operating systems automatically.
+- **Select Custom Multiple**:
+  - Interactive multiselect with Spacebar checkboxes.
+  - Or type comma-separated values & ranges: e.g. `1,2,5-8` or `all`.
+  - Collision protection: If VMID already exists, prompts to **[S]kip**, **[O]verwrite**, or enter a **[N]ew VMID**.
+  - Automatically selects active storage volume (e.g. `local-lvm`, `local-zfs`, `ceph`).
+  - Converts restored VM into a template using `qm template <vmid>`.
+  - Deletes `.vma.zst` files immediately after restore to save disk space.
+
+### 2️⃣ Option 2: Uninstall OS Templates
+- **Select All**: Scans your node for all installed Convoy template VMs and completely purges them (`qm destroy <vmid> --purge`). Requires typing `yes` to prevent accidental deletion.
+- **Select Custom Multiple**:
+  - Detects and lists existing template VMs on your node.
+  - Checkbox selection allows selecting multiple specific template VMIDs to purge together.
+  - Cleans up associated storage disks and cluster lock files.
+
+### 3️⃣ Option 3: List Installed Templates
+- Displays a clean status table of all VM templates present in `/etc/pve/qemu-server/`.
+
+### 4️⃣ Option 4: Coport TUI (Convoy 2.0)
+- Directly downloads and runs ConvoyPanel's official next-generation utility (`coport-linux-x64`).
+
+---
+
+## 🤖 Non-Interactive / Automation Flags
+
+You can also call `run.sh` directly without the interactive menu for automated scripts or crons:
+
+```bash
+# Install all templates automatically
+./run.sh --install-all
+
+# Uninstall all Convoy templates automatically
+./run.sh --uninstall-all
+
+# List all currently installed templates
+./run.sh --list
+```

+### 📖 README (first 10k chars)
+
+```
+
+# ZORIN-M4
+
+A Windows voice companion using Gemini Live native audio, local memory, and verified desktop actions. The voice system is adapted from the user's AI Studio ZIP; its React UI, HUD, themes and browser proxy are not imported.
+
+## Start on this computer
+
+Double-click **RUN-ZORIN-VOICE.bat** in `I:\ZORIN-M4`. The dependencies and local models are already installed here. Wait for **ZORIN-M4 ready**, then speak or type.
+
+```powershell
+cd I:\ZORIN-M4
+.\run.bat
+```
+
+Examples:
+
+- “Hello Zorin.”
+- “Chrome kholo.”
+- “YouTube kholo.” / “यूट्यूब खोलो।”
+- “Open YouTube on Chrome.” / “Click on the fourth video.”
+- “Zorin, Chrome pe YouTube khol.” / “Chrome par YouTube search kar.”
+- “Open Notepad and type: hello boss.”
+- “Click Settings.”
+- “Scroll down.” / “Volume 30.”
+- “Actually rehne de, Steam khol.”
+- “Wait, cancel that.”
+- “Remember that I prefer short replies.”
+
+The microphone listens continuously while enabled. There is no wake-word gate: spoken commands can execute immediately. Use headphones to keep the assistant's own voice and media audio out of the microphone. Avoid switching windows while it is carrying out a desktop task; it stops when focus changes unexpectedly.
+
+| Launcher | Microphone | Spoken replies |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `RUN-ZORIN-VOICE.bat` or `run.bat` | On | On |
+| `RUN-KEYBOARD-WITH-VOICE.bat` or `run.bat --keyboard` | Off | On |
+| `run.bat --text` | Off | Off |
+| `SETUP-AUDIO.bat` | Diagnostic only | Test announcement |
+
+**`--text` explicitly disables voice.** Close with `/quit` or Ctrl+C. Closing the console also releases the local model servers. A second assistant instance is rejected to prevent duplicate microphone capture and actions.
+
+## Microphone and voice
+
+The default is **Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Preview + Puck**, matching the model and speaker in `zorion---m4-ai-assistant.zip`. It uses one continuous audio-to-audio connection, with 16 kHz microphone input and 24 kHz speech playback. It does not wait for separate Groq transcription, text reasoning and TTS requests. Delivery is adapted from the archive: confident, expressive, playful and casual, with everyday Hindi/Hinglish instead of formal Hindi. The UI and its unverified browser-success acknowledgements were not imported. The original ZIP is untouched.
+
+Run `run.bat` or `RUN-ZORIN-VOICE.bat`. `run.bat --keyboard` uses Live speech with typed input and no microphone. `run.bat --text` runs the existing text controller. `run.bat --cascade` restores the previous voice pipeline described below. Live mode needs the saved `GEMINI_API_KEY`; it does not silently replace Puck with another voice if Google is unavailable. Connection failures are shown and retried; `/reconnect` reconnects explicitly. Typed desktop commands remain available during an established session's network outage. Initial connection failure exits with an error.
+
+**Data flow:** microphone audio passes through a local speech/noise gate before admitted speech is streamed to Google. During replies, candidate interruptions are held and checked with the previously approved Groq speech-recognition service; only an assistant address or explicit stop command admits them to Gemini. Audio is not saved locally. Recent dialogue and explicit preferences are included for continuity. With the user's existing `cloud_activity_titles: true` choice, settled app/tab titles and process names can also be sent; page contents, screenshots and typed fields are not part of these ambient updates. Use `/mic off`, `/mic on`, `/quiet` and `/unquiet`. `/forget-memory` erases local memories and starts a new Live session without reusing the old session handle; it cannot retroactively erase data already sent to the provider.
+
+**Screen sharing is now separately enabled with explicit permission.** Changed active-window images are sent to Google Gemini Live at most once every two seconds, resized to fit 1280×960. These images include visible page contents. `/screen off` pauses new images and disables visual click fallback; `/screen on` restores both. The preference persists. Protected/password and excluded private/security/terminal windows are skipped; this is not automatic redaction of everything visible in an ordinary page. Frames stay in RAM locally. The title-only activity prompts described above remain a separate path. Video frames use Google's [documented Live video input](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/live-api/get-started-websocket#send-video).
+
+The Live microphone gate now uses a 100-RMS minimum, VAD mode 2, a noise-relative threshold and a lower continuation threshold to preserve quieter syllables. Admitted speech receives bounded 2× input gain; gate decisions still use raw audio. Reply interruptions still need sustained speech plus a recognized assistant address or stop phrase. The user's normal-volume check admitted one utterance; it did not transcribe words, and is not proof of perfect recognition.
+
+Live speech is generated in context, not selected from fixed jokes or cached acknowledgements. A settled app/tab change can prompt a relevance check that chooses a specific thought or silence before sending anything to the voice model. The previous 20-second conversational-pause trigger is removed. New speech, changed context and quiet mode discard pending comments. Timing controls limit interruptions; they do not schedule a remark every interval. Quiet mode persists. There are still model inference and code: this is not AGI, consciousness, or a guarantee of no repetition. The exact voice delivery can vary.
+
+Tools call the existing verified local controller, wait for its outcome, and report failures honestly. Ambient events cannot authorize desktop actions. A single user request cannot execute twice because the model repeats a tool call. Sensitive-action confirmations, local `/cancel`, and focus protection remain. Confirmed model interruptions clear queued audio and stop remaining actions. While ZORIN is replying, begin with "Zorin, ..." or say "stop" / "ruko". Ordinary background conversation is rejected rather than pausing playback. When he is quiet, ordinary speech still works without an address. Use headphones: the Python audio device path does not inherit the browser's echo cancellation/noise suppression from the ZIP. Server automatic VAD is disabled. Local WebRTC VAD, a noise-relative energy threshold, sustained speech checks, preserved onset audio and a minimum 600 ms end silence control speech boundaries. Real-room microphone accuracy still needs user validation. This is not speaker identification: a clear nearby voice while idle, or another person explicitly saying the stop command, can still be admitted.
+
+A persistent playback stream buffers 200 ms before starting and queues subsequent audio continuously. In the initial 125 ms-buffer probe, Puck started playing at 0.765 s and 1.297 s after two text prompts with zero underruns. These are text-input timings, not microphone-to-answer guarantees. Actual desktop work and verification add their own delay. See `TEST_REPORT.md` for failures and limitations. Google account quotas and preview availability apply; no billing changes have been made. [Official Live capabilities](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/live-api/capabilities), [session resumption](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/live-api/session-management).
+
+Configuration: `voice.mode`, `voice.live_model`, `voice.live_voice`, `voice.live_endpoint_ms`, `voice.live_reply_protection`, `voice.live_min_energy`; delivery lives in `persona/live.py`. `SETUP-AUDIO.bat` still selects the shared microphone/output devices, but its old voice audition tests the cascade voice. Use `/voice-test` inside a Live session to hear Puck, or run `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -X utf8 scripts\check_live_voice.py --play` with ZORIN closed. That standalone probe uses synthetic text and does not open the microphone or execute desktop actions.
+
+The following provider, cache and standalone Whisper details apply only to `--cascade`:
+
+### Previous pipeline: --cascade
+
+The selected provider is **Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS Preview**, using **Algieba** with the smooth, calm delivery chosen by the user. If that model is unavailable or reaches its quota, the configured Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS fallback uses the same speaker and delivery instructions. The console reports the actual backend; matching settings do not guarantee identical delivery across models. This computer's saved Google AI Studio key has passed real synthesis and conversation checks. On another installation, add your own key to `.env` as `GEMINI_API_KEY`, then restart. `gemini_tts_voice` and `gemini_tts_style` select the speaker and delivery. The brain uses everyday Hindi with familiar English words, avoiding literary/Sanskrit-heavy wording. Voice auditions and user feedback are recorded in TEST_REPORT.md.
+
+Gemini TTS sends reply text and delivery instructions to Google. At the user's choice, recognition now sends detected speech segments to Groq's `whisper-large-v3` using the saved `GROQ_API_KEY`, with local Whisper as fallback. Voice activity detection remains local and microphone audio is not saved to disk. To keep recognition entirely local, set `stt_provider: local_whisper` and leave `cloud_stt_fallback: false`. Cloud recognition has a five-second request timeout and failed providers cool down before another attempt. See [Groq speech recognition](https://console.groq.com/docs/speech-to-text). Google's Developer API lists a limited free tier; account quotas apply. Do not enable billing if you want to stay on the free tier. See [Google speech generation](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/speech-generation) and [Developer API pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing#gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview).
+
+Alternatives under `voice.tts_provider`: `google` means Google Translate through gTTS (no key, no selectable male/emotion preset); `edge` uses Microsoft's online Hindi/Indian English voices (no key); `kokoro` uses local voices. Onl
+
+```

+### 📖 README (first 10k chars)
+
+```
+
+# AKVM Panel v1.0
+
+Modern KVM management panel with dark UI (HKVM-inspired), public IP pool, web console, and working cloud-init.
+
+## Features
+
+- **Dark modern UI** matching HKVM Panel style (sidebar, cards, stats)
+- **Admin-only VM creation** — regular users cannot create VMs
+- **Public IPv4 pool** — store public IPs and assign them when deploying
+- **Private (NAT) or Public** network mode per VM
+- **Cloud-init** with:
+  - `root` user + password
+  - OS default sudo user (`ubuntu` / `debian`) with same password
+  - SSH password auth + PermitRootLogin
+  - Root FS resize
+- **Web Terminal (SSH console)** via Paramiko
+- **QEMU serial** console + web SSH shell
+- **SSH** works out of the box (hostfwd + cloud-init)
+- Fixed **edit VM** (port conflict checks, disk grow, password update)
+- User management, settings, audit log, notifications
+
+## Requirements (host)
+
+```bash
+sudo apt update
+sudo apt install -y qemu-system-x86 qemu-utils cloud-image-utils wget curl sshpass python3-pip python3-venv
+# KVM support
+sudo apt install -y cpu-checker
+kvm-ok
+```
+
+## Install & Run
+
+### Quick install (recommended)
+
+One command sets up everything — host dependencies, Python venv, and a systemd service so the panel auto-starts on boot:
+
+```bash
+cd akvm
+sudo bash install.sh
+```
+
+That's it. It will print the panel URL when done (default `http://YOUR_IP:5000`).
+
+Manage it afterward with:
+```bash
+systemctl status akvm
+systemctl restart akvm
+journalctl -u akvm -f
+```
+
+During install, the script automatically prints your **AKVM License Key** and **Install ID** (see the `── AKVM License ──` block in the output). Enter that key on the **License** page to activate the panel.
+
+### Manual install
+
+```bash
+cd akvm
+python3 -m venv venv
+source venv/bin/activate
+pip install -r requirements.txt
+python akvm.py
+```
+
+Open `http://YOUR_IP:5000`
+
+**Default login:** `admin` / `admin123`
+
+## Notes
+
+- VMs use user-mode networking + SSH port forward. Public IP is stored/displayed and used as the advertised SSH host; traffic still hits the host on the assigned port.
+- For true L2 public IP binding you would need bridge/macvtap setup on the host (not included for safety/simplicity).
+- Change the default root password under **Settings**.
+- Only **admins** can create / edit / delete VMs and manage users & public IPs.
+
+
+## License
+
+Each install has its own **Install ID**. The matching **License Key** is derived
+from it (HMAC-SHA256) and is printed automatically during `install.sh` in the
+`── AKVM License ──` block.
+
+To show your license key again at any time, run:
+
+```bash
+pythan3 show_license.py
+```
+
+(If your install lives elsewhere, point the script at your `akvm` directory —
+usage: `python show_license.py /path/to/akvm`.)
+
+Then enter the key on **Admin → License** to activate the panel. A revoked
+install is automatically locked by the periodic revocation check.
+
+
+## Additional nodes (node.py)
+
+1. In Panel → Settings set **Node register token**.
+2. On another host:
+
+```bash
+pip install flask requests psutil
+export AKVM_PANEL_URL=http://PANEL_IP:5000
+export AKVM_NODE_TOKEN=your_token
+export AKVM_NODE_NAME=node-2
+export AKVM_AGENT_PORT=5050
+python3 node.py
+```
+
+3. The node appears under **Management → Nodes**.
+
+## Nested KVM / CPU
+
+- Nested KVM on → `-cpu host,+vmx,+svm` (guest can use KVM)
+- Nested off + host KVM → `-cpu kvm64`
+- No host KVM → TCG `-cpu qemu64`
+
+## SMBIOS
+
+Configured under Settings — shows as manufacturer/product in neofetch/fastfetch (default manufacturer: Michael).
+
+
+## REST API
+
+Create a key under **Profile → API Keys**.
+
+```bash
+# User API — list my VMs
+curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" http://HOST:5000/api/v1/user/vms
+
+# User API — start / stop / restart
+curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" http://HOST:5000/api/v1/user/vms/VM_ID/start
+
+# Admin API — list all VMs
+curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_KEY" http://HOST:5000/api/v1/admin/vms
+
+# Admin API — create VM
+curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  -d '{"name":"web1","os_template":"ubuntu-24.04","ram_mb":2048,"cpu_cores":2,"storage_gb":20}' \
+  http://HOST:5000/api/v1/admin/vms
+
+# Admin API — delete VM
+curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_KEY" http://HOST:5000/api/v1/admin/vms/VM_ID
+```
+
+Passwords are never returned by the API list/detail endpoints.
+
+
+## License verification
+
+The product key is **not** stored in plaintext. Activation compares a salted SHA-256
+digest against XOR-masked material embedded in the binary. Tampering with
+`license_activated` in the database is insufficient without a matching digest.
+
+
+```
+
+

+
+updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
+
+```

+#### Table: `chat_turns`

+```sql
+

+```

+## What You Get
+
+- **50 ToS-friendly providers. 1.3B+ free tokens every month.** Use free, paid, subscription, and local models from one searchable UI without putting your account at risk. FCC follows provider terms and removes integrations if they stop being allowed.
+- **10 coding agents. One model catalog.** Run [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview), [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), [Pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi), [OpenCode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode), [Cline](https://github.com/cline/cline), [Hermes](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent), [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), [Grok Build](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build), [Muse Code](https://research.meta.ai/blog/introducing-muse-code-and-muse-spark-1-2/), or [Aider](https://aider.chat/) with your FCC models.
+- **Keep coding through provider outages.** After retries are exhausted, FCC automatically tries your next configured model without making you restart the turn—across every client.
+- **Up to 90% fewer terminal-output tokens.** Optional [RTK](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk) filters common command output, while five FCC optimizations handle quota probes, command-prefix detection, titles, suggestions, and filepaths without calling a provider.
+- **Terminal, desktop, IDE, or phone.** Work through native launchers, [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/), [Codex App](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app), [JetBrains](https://www.jetbrains.com/), [Discord](https://discord.com/), or [Telegram](https://telegram.org/).
+- **Private local chat.** Use Chat Sessions in Admin to talk with any configured FCC model, with persisted history, thinking controls, streaming, fallback, and compaction.
+- **Voice notes in. Code out.** Talk to your agent using local [Whisper](https://github.com/openai/whisper) or [NVIDIA NIM](https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/speech/latest/asr/deploy-asr-models/whisper.html) transcription.
+- **Agent capabilities stay intact.** Stream responses, use tools, preserve native interleaved thinking for maximum performance, send images, and route [Fable](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/fable), [Opus](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/opus), [Sonnet](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/sonnet), and [Haiku](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/haiku) independently with compatible models.
+
+Free-tier availability and limits are controlled by each provider and may change.

+## Quick Start
+
+<a id="install"></a>
+
+### 1. Install Or Update
+
+macOS/Linux:
+
+```bash
+curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alishahryar1/free-claude-code/main/scripts/install.sh" | sh
+```
+
+Windows PowerShell:
+
+```powershell
+& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alishahryar1/free-claude-code/main/scripts/install.ps1")))
+```
+
+Re-run the same command to update. When prompted, choose at least one coding agent and optionally RTK. You can review the installers before running them: [install.sh](scripts/install.sh) and [install.ps1](scripts/install.ps1).
+
+### 2. Start FCC
+
+#### Windows
+
+Open **Free Claude Code** from your desktop or Start menu.
+
+#### macOS
+
+Open **Free Claude Code** from your desktop or Applications folder.
+
+#### Linux
+
+Run:
+
+```bash
+fcc-server
+```
+
+FCC opens the Admin UI after starting. On Windows and macOS, use the tray or
+menu-bar icon to open Admin, restart, or quit. When using `fcc-server`, keep its
+terminal open.
+
+<a id="nvidia-nim-provider"></a>
+
+### 3. Configure NVIDIA NIM
+
+1. Create an API key at [build.nvidia.com/settings/api-keys](https://build.nvidia.com/settings/api-keys).
+2. Open the Admin UI URL from the server log.
+3. Paste the key into `NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY`.
+4. Leave `MODEL` on the default `nvidia_nim/nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b`, or search the model dropdown and select another model.
+5. Click **Apply**.
+
+To protect the local proxy with a bearer token, enable **Proxy Authentication**
+in Admin.
+
+<div align="center">
+  <img src="assets/admin-page.png" alt="Free Claude Code Admin UI" width="700">
+</div>
+
+### 4. Run Your Coding Agent
+
+Claude Code:
+
+```bash
+fcc-claude
+```
+
+Codex:
+
+```bash
+fcc-codex
+```
+
+Pi:
+
+```bash
+fcc-pi
+```
+
+OpenCode:
+
+```bash
+fcc-opencode
+```
+
+Cline:
+
+```bash
+fcc-cline
+```
+
+Hermes:
+
+```bash
+fcc-hermes
+```
+
+DeepSeek Harness Web:
+
+```bash
+fcc-dsh
+```
+
+Grok Build:
+
+```bash
+fcc-grok
+```
+
+Muse Code:
+
+```bash
+fcc-muse
+```
+
+Aider:
+
+```bash
+fcc-aider
+```
+
+<a id="model-picker"></a>
+
+<div align="center">
+  <img src="assets/cc-model-picker.png" alt="Claude Code model picker showing FCC models" width="700">
+  <p><em>Select an FCC model from Claude Code's native <code>/model</code> picker.</em></p>
+</div>

+## Choose A Provider
+
+1. Open a provider link below for its key, models, or setup instructions.
+2. In the Admin UI, configure the listed setting. For OpenAI, use
+   **Providers → Connected accounts** instead.
+3. Search the `MODEL` dropdown and select a model. If the provider cannot list
+   models, enter `<provider-id>/<exact-provider-model-id>` manually.
+4. Click **Apply**.
+
+Optional: add an ordered **Fallback Models** list under **Model Config**. It
+applies to every connected client. A failed request may reach and consume usage
+from more than one provider before succeeding.
+

+selections to your configured default, or the built-in default when `MODEL` itself
+is retired. Configure that default provider in Admin if its credentials are missing.
+GitHub Copilot is a separate service; connect it through **Connected accounts** in Admin.

+# 🚀 Nova Website Template
+
+Welcome! Thank you for purchasing Nova - a modern, responsive website template for hosting services.
+
+## 📋 Important Notes
+
+> **Please read these terms carefully before proceeding:**
+
+- ❌ **No refunds** - All sales are final
+- 🔧 **Custom modifications** require additional payment
+- 💡 **Basic support** is provided, but self-help is expected
+- ⚠️ **Support exclusions** - No support for heavily modified websites or removed footer credits
+
+## 🛠️ Getting Started
+
+### Configuration Files
+Customize your website by modifying these key files:
+
+| File/Directory | Purpose |
+|----------------|---------|
+| `/app/config/sections/` | Main content configuration |
+| `ui.json` | Currencies, colors, and UI settings |
+| `hero.json` | Hero section content |
+| `Footer.tsx` | Footer component and logo |
+| `language.json` | Language and translations |
+| `layout.tsx` | Meta data and SEO settings |
+
+### 🎨 Quick Customization Guide
+
+1. **Colors & UI**: Edit `ui.json`
+2. **Content**: Modify files in `/app/config/sections/`
+3. **Branding**: Update `hero.json` and `Footer.tsx`
+4. **Languages**: Configure `language.json`
+5. **SEO**: Update `layout.tsx`
+
+
+
+1. **Install Dependencies**
+   ```bash
+   npm install
+   ```
+
+2. **Install PM2 Process Manager**
+   ```bash
+   npm install -g pm2
+   ```
+
+3. **Build and Start the Application**
+   ```bash
+   npm run build
+   pm2 start npm --name "nova-website" -- start
+   ```
+
+   The application will run on `localhost:3000`
+
+4. **PM2 Management Commands**
+   ```bash
+   pm2 list              # View running processes
+   pm2 restart nova-website    # Restart the app
+   pm2 stop nova-website       # Stop the app
+   pm2 delete nova-website     # Delete the app from PM2
+   pm2 logs nova-website       # View logs
+   ```
+
+### 🔧 Nginx Reverse Proxy Setup
+
+Create an Nginx configuration file for your domain:
+
+```bash
+sudo nano /etc/nginx/sites-available/your-domain.com
+```
+
+Add the following configuration:
+
+```nginx
+server {
+    listen 80;
+    server_name your-domain.com www.your-domain.com;
+
+    location / {
+        proxy_pass http://localhost:3000;
+        proxy_http_version 1.1;
+        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
+        proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';
+        proxy_set_header Host $host;
+        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
+        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
+        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
+        proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;
+    }
+}
+```
+
+**Enable the site:**
+```bash
+sudo ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/your-domain.com /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
+sudo nginx -t
+sudo systemctl reload nginx
+```
+
+**For HTTPS with Let's Encrypt:**
+```bash
+sudo apt install certbot python3-certbot-nginx
+sudo certbot --nginx -d your-domain.com -d www.your-domain.com
+```
+
+**Important Notes:**
+- Replace `your-domain.com` with your actual domain name
+- Ensure your domain points to your server's IP address
+- The application must be running on port 3000 (as configured with PM2)
+- Test your configuration with `sudo nginx -t` before reloading
+
+### ☁️ Vercel Deployment Guide
+
+Deploy your Nova website template to Vercel for easy hosting and automatic deployments.
+
+#### Prerequisites
+- GitHub account
+- Vercel account (free tier available)
+- Your project pushed to a GitHub repository
+
+#### Step-by-Step Deployment
+
+1. **Prepare Your Repository**
+   ```bash
+   git init
+   git add .
+   git commit -m "Initial commit"
+   git branch -M main
+   git remote add origin https://github.com/yourusername/your-repo-name.git
+   git push -u origin main
+   ```
+
+2. **Connect to Vercel**
+   - Go to [vercel.com](https://vercel.com) and sign in
+   - Click "New Project"
+   - Import your GitHub repository
+   - Vercel will automatically detect it's a Next.js project
+
+3. **Configure Build Settings**
+   - **Framework Preset**: Next.js (auto-detected)
+   - **Root Directory**: `./` (default)
+   - **Build Command**: `npm run build` (auto-detected)
+   - **Output Directory**: `.next` (auto-detected)
+   - **Install Command**: `npm install` (auto-detected)
+
+4. **Environment Variables** (if needed)
+   - Add any environment variables in the Vercel dashboard
+   - Go to Project Settings → Environment Variables
+   - Add variables like `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` if your app uses them
+
+5. **Deploy**
+   - Click "Deploy"
+   - Vercel will build and deploy your site automatically
+   - You'll get a URL like `https://your-project-name.vercel.app`
+
+#### Custom Domain Setup
+
+1. **Add Custom Domain**
+   - Go to your project dashboard
+   - Click "Domains" tab
+   - Add your domain (e.g., `yourdomain.com`)
+
+2. **Configure DNS**
+   - Add a CNAME record pointing to `cname.vercel-dns.com`
+   - Or add an A record pointing to Vercel's IP addresses
+
+3. **SSL Certificate**
+   - Vercel automatically provides SSL certificates
+   - HTTPS will be enabled automatically
+
+#### Vercel Configuration File (Optional)
+
+Create a `vercel.json` file in your project root for advanced configuration:
+
+```json
+{
+  "framework": "nextjs",
+  "buildCommand": "npm run build",
+  "outputDirectory": ".next",
+  "installCommand": "npm install",
+  "headers": [
+    {
+      "source": "/(.*)",
+      "headers": [
+        {
+          "key": "X-Content-Type-Options",
+          "value": "nosniff"
+        },
+        {
+          "key": "X-Frame-Options",
+          "value": "DENY"
+        },
+        {
+          "key": "X-XSS-Protection",
+          "value": "1; mode=block"
+        }
+      ]
+    }
+  ]
+}
+```
+
+#### Automatic Deployments
+
+- **Push to main branch**: Automatically triggers production deployment
+- **Pull requests**: Creates preview deployments
+- **Branch deployments**: Each branch gets its own URL
+
+#### Vercel CLI (Alternative Method)
+
+```bash
+# Install Vercel CLI
+npm i -g vercel
+
+# Login to Vercel
+vercel login
+
+# Deploy from your project directory
+vercel
+
+# Deploy to production
+vercel --prod
+```
+
+#### Performance Optimizations
+
+Vercel automatically provides:
+- **Edge Network**: Global CDN for fast loading
+- **Image Optimization**: Automatic image optimization
+- **Automatic HTTPS**: SSL certificates
+- **Analytics**: Built-in performance monitoring
+
+#### Troubleshooting
+
+**Common Issues:**
+- **Build failures**: Check your `package.json` scripts
+- **Environment variables**: Ensure they're set in Vercel dashboard
+- **Static files**: Place them in the `public` directory
+- **API routes**: Must be in `app/api/` or `pages/api/` directory
+
+**Useful Commands:**
+```bash
+# View deployment logs
+vercel logs
+
+# Check deployment status
+vercel ls
+
+# Remove deployment
+vercel rm your-project-name
+```

+### 📖 README (first 10k chars)
+
+```
+
+# NobitaHost
+
+Full Node.js web panel — card-based dark UI with user dashboard, admin dashboard, user/team management, CMS content pages, analytics, 2FA, email auth flows and fully customisable settings.
+
+## PHP Edition (CasaOS UI) — `php/`
+
+The whole panel is also available as a **dependency-free PHP 8 port** (plain PHP + SQLite, no
+Composer, no build step) with a **CasaOS-style desktop shell** on every page: glass topbar with
+live CPU/RAM/disk/net/temp widgets, icon dock, wallpaper background and an app-grid home.
+It is a 1:1 port — 175 routes, 70 views, 26 tables, the same 13,653-entry command dataset and the
+full Cloudflare / plans / blog / CMS feature set. The Node app above is untouched.
+
+```bash
+cd php
+php cli/setup.php     # create + seed SQLite DB (admin/admin123, demo/demo123)
+bash serve.sh         # php -S 0.0.0.0:8080 router.php
+```
+
+Apache: document root → `php/` (`.htaccess` included). nginx: `try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php`.
+Full docs: [`php/README.md`](php/README.md).
+
+## Ports
+
+| Service | Port | URL |
+|---|---|---|
+| Web Panel | **3001** | http://localhost:3001 |
+| REST API | **3002** | http://localhost:3002 |
+
+## Quick Start
+
+```bash
+npm install
+npm run build        # init DB + seed settings, content & default admin (admin/admin123)
+npm start            # web panel  -> :3001
+npm run api          # api        -> :3002
+```
+
+With PM2 (two apps):
+
+```bash
+npm install
+npm run build
+pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
+pm2 save
+pm2 startup
+```
+
+### Create a user (CLI)
+
+```bash
+npm run createuser                       # interactive
+npm run createuser -- --username john --email john@x.com --password secret123 --role admin
+```
+
+## Features
+
+- **Auth**: Login, Register, Forgot/Reset password (email), Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP + QR)
+- **User pages**: Home, Team, Tutorials, Command, Analytics, Projects, Links, About, Activity, Profile
+- **Admin**: Dashboard, Create User, User Management (edit/suspend/delete), Settings, Content, Tutorials, Activity Log
+- **Team**: main user creates sub-users, edits, suspends, deletes them
+- **Settings (General)**: Panel Name, Logo (upload / URL / emoji) with live preview, Favicon (upload/URL) with preview
+- **Settings (Background)**: image/video upload or URL, 4K Wallpapers source picker (`cute-kawaii-wallpapers`, `ultrawide-monitor-hd-wallpapers`, `cool-wallpapers`, `black-dark`, `aesthetic-wallpapers`, `space`, `cr7-wallpapers`, `all`), overlay toggle
+- **Settings (Music)**: mp3/video URL or upload, or YouTube background music widget
+- **Settings (Appearance)**: transparent bar, blur bar, card radius, accent color
+- **Settings (Email/SMTP)**: welcome + password reset emails
+- **Analytics**: page views (last 7 days), login history, user stats — both web and `:3002/api/analytics`
+
+## API (port 3002)
+
+```
+GET    /api/status
+POST   /api/auth/login          { username, password }
+POST   /api/auth/register       { username, email, password }
+GET    /api/auth/me             (cookie JWT)
+GET    /api/activity
+GET    /api/analytics
+GET    /api/settings
+PUT    /api/settings            (admin)
+GET    /api/admin/users         (admin)
+POST   /api/admin/users         (admin) { username, email, password, role }
+PUT    /api/admin/users/:id     (admin)
+PUT    /api/admin/users/:id/suspend  (admin) { suspended: true }
+DELETE /api/admin/users/:id     (admin)
+```
+
+Auth uses an httpOnly cookie (`nh_token`) so the web panel (:3001) and API (:3002) share the same login.
+
+## Env (`.env`)
+
+```
+PORT=3001
+API_PORT=3002
+JWT_SECRET=...
+PANEL_URL=http://localhost:3001
+SMTP_HOST / SMTP_PORT / SMTP_USER / SMTP_PASS / MAIL_FROM
+```
+
+## Structure
+
+```
+src/
+  server.js          web panel (:3001)
+  api.js             REST API (:3002)
+  db.js              SQLite (better-sqlite3)
+  settings.js        panel settings + wallpaper sources
+  mailer.js          SMTP email
+  routes/            web, auth, api routes
+  middleware/        jwt auth, multer upload
+scripts/
+  build.js           setup / seed
+  createuser.js      CLI user creation
+views/               EJS (user + admin + auth + errors)
+public/              css, js, uploads
+```
+
+> Default admin: `admin` / `admin123` — change it after first login! (Same defaults in the PHP edition.)
+
+

+<div align="center">
+
+# ⚡ vPanel Pro v3.1.1
+### Enterprise-Grade QEMU/KVM Virtualization Platform with Full Arix Theme v2.1.3 Integration
+
+[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-v18+-339933?style=for-the-badge&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org)
+[![Express](https://img.shields.io/badge/Express.js-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=express&logoColor=white)](https://expressjs.com)
+[![QEMU](https://img.shields.io/badge/QEMU-Virtualization-FF6600?style=for-the-badge&logo=qemu&logoColor=white)](https://www.qemu.org/)
+[![MongoDB](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB-47A248?style=for-the-badge&logo=mongodb&logoColor=white)](https://www.mongodb.com/)
+[![Arix Theme](https://img.shields.io/badge/Arix_Theme-v2.1.3-4A35CF?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/nobita329/vpanel-pro)
+[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/Release-v3.1.1-6366F1?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/nobita329/vpanel-pro/releases)
+[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE)
+
+*A complete, high-performance virtualization platform featuring strict 2-Panel Separation (👑 Admin Control Plane vs 👤 Tenant User Panel), native Arix Theme v2.1.3 design system, multi-session SSH console, real-time telemetry area charts, cluster nodes, and automated CI/CD releases.*
+
+---
+
+</div>
+
+## 🌟 Key Highlights & Features
+
+### 🎨 1. Full Arix Theme v2.1.3 Design System
+- **Cosmic Glassmorphism Visuals**: Clean dark-mode UI with customizable blur (`--panel-blur`), opacity (`--panel-transparency`), and glowing accent borders.
+- **Ambient Themes & Backgrounds**: Integrated 4K Wallpaper browser (Anime, Space, Dark/AMOLED, Cyberpunk, Nature), custom video backgrounds (`.mp4`, `.webm`), and interactive audio cues (`online`, `offline`, `copy`).
+- **Unified Navigation**: Arix responsive sidebar with active glowing indicators, collapsible state, mobile drawer, and topbar user controls.
+
+### 🖥️ 2. Signature Arix Server Console Dashboard
+- **Top Header & Spec Summary**: Displays server name, OS distro, allocated vCPUs, RAM, and SSH port.
+- **Unified Power Controls**: Real-time 3-state power button group (`START` with blue active glow, `RESTART`, `STOP` with danger red glow and safety confirmations).
+- **2-Column Split Console Grid**:
+  - **Left (Terminal Window)**:
+    - Multi-session SSH Terminal with **24/7 background persistence**.
+    - 4-corner interactive mouse resize handles and quick presets (`169×33`, `Fit`, `Full`).
+    - **noVNC Graphical Desktop**: Low-latency HTML5 remote framebuffer console for QEMU guests with `Ctrl+Alt+Del`.
+    - **Live Boot Logs**: Real-time serial kernel streaming with AI Virtualization Diagnostics for boot failure remediation.
+    - **Interactive Command Prompt Bar**: Terminal input (`» Type a command...`) supporting Enter dispatch and Up/Down history navigation.
+  - **Right (7 Real-Time Stat Cards)**:
+    - **Address**: Hostname & port with 1-click clipboard copy.
+    - **Uptime**: Live guest uptime counter (`Xd Xh Xm Xs` / `Offline`).
+    - **CPU Load**: Real-time % utilization.
+    - **Memory**: Used MB vs. Total Allocated MB.
+    - **Disk**: Live consumed storage vs. Virtual disk capacity.
+    - **Network (Inbound)**: Live RX throughput (KiB/s).
+    - **Network (Outbound)**: Live TX throughput (KiB/s).
+- **Bottom 3 Telemetry Area Charts**:
+  - Real-time Bézier SVG area charts for **CPU Load**, **Memory**, and **Network** (inbound/outbound dual metrics) updated every 2.5 seconds.
+
+### 👑 3. Admin Control Plane vs. Tenant User Panel
+- **Cluster Nodes Architecture**: Manage virtualization nodes, resource capacity, daemon ports, and guest allocations.
+- **Virtual Machines & Storage**: Deploy VMs with cloud-init images (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, CentOS, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux). Manage Local Directory, LVM, and NFS storage pools.
+- **User Management & Delegation**: Subuser access control, TOTP Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), and 1-click **Admin User Impersonation** with a floating return bar.
+- **MongoDB Management Studio**: Integrated Mongo-Express style database manager for collections, documents, and query execution.
+- **Command Palette (`Ctrl + K`)**: Universal spotlight modal for instant server search, navigation, and power dispatch.
+- **Plugin System & Webhooks**: Native integrations for **Discord Rich Embeds**, **Telegram Bot Alerts**, and outgoing signed HTTP POST webhooks.
+
+### 🔄 4. Automated CI/CD & GitHub Actions Release
+- **Automated Workflow (`.github/workflows/release.yml`)**: Automatically generates semver tags (`v3.1.1`) and publishes GitHub Releases with release notes upon pushes to `main`.
+

+## 🏗️ Architecture & Stack
+
+```text
+┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│                        vPanel Pro Frontend                             │
+│       Arix Theme v2.1.3 • EJS • Xterm.js • Socket.IO • Lucide Icons    │
+└───────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
+                                    │ HTTP / WebSocket (Port 3001)
+┌───────────────────────────────────▼────────────────────────────────────┐
+│                         Node.js & Express Core                         │
+│     Cluster Node Orchestrator • MongoDB • Auth / RBAC • Event Plugins  │
+└─────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────┘
+                  │                                      │
+┌─────────────────▼──────────────┐     ┌─────────────────▼───────────────┐
+│     QEMU Hypervisor Engine     │     │      vPanel Guest Agent         │
+│   (KVM / TCG • VirtIO • VNC)   │     │   (Serial Daemon / SSH / Files) │
+└────────────────────────────────┘     └─────────────────────────────────┘
+```

+## 📋 System Requirements
+
+- **Operating System**: Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian 11+, RHEL/CentOS 9+, Fedora, Arch Linux)
+- **Node.js**: v18.0.0+ (v20+ recommended)
+- **Database**: MongoDB 5.0+ (or Docker container `mongo:latest`)
+- **Virtualization**: QEMU (`qemu-system-x86_64`, `qemu-img`)
+- **Utilities**: `cloud-image-utils` (`cloud-localds`), `wget`, `openssl`, `python3`

+## 🚀 Installation & Quick Start
+
+### Option 1: Automated Installer (Recommended)
+
+```bash
+# Clone the repository
+git clone https://github.com/nobita329/vpanel-pro.git
+cd vpanel-pro
+
+# Interactive installation wizard
+sudo bash install.sh
+
+# Or 1-line unattended install
+sudo bash install.sh --install -y --admin-user admin --admin-email admin@vpanel.local --admin-pass 'your_secure_password'
+```
+
+#### Installer CLI Options:
+| Flag | Description | Default |
+| :--- | :--- | :--- |
+| `1`, `--install` | Full automated Debian/Ubuntu installation | - |
+| `2`, `--create-admin` | Create or reset administrator account | - |
+| `3`, `--update` | Pull latest updates and zero-downtime reload | - |
+| `4`, `--pm2` | PM2 cluster management menu | - |
+| `5`, `--uninstall` | Safe uninstaller wizard | - |
+| `--admin-user <user>` | Administrator username | `admin` |
+| `--admin-email <email>`| Administrator email address | `admin@vpanel.local` |
+| `--admin-pass <pass>` | Administrator password | Generated random |
+| `--no-pm2` | Skip PM2 daemon setup | `0` |
+| `-y`, `--non-interactive` | Run without interactive prompts | `0` |
+
+---
+
+### Option 2: Manual Setup
+
+```bash
+# 1. Clone repository & install dependencies
+git clone https://github.com/nobita329/vpanel-pro.git
+cd vpanel-pro
+npm install
+
+# 2. Build assets
+npm run build
+
+# 3. Create administrator account
+npm run createuser
+
+# 4. Start vPanel Pro
+npm start
+```
+
+---
+
+### Option 3: Production Deployment with PM2
+
+```bash
+# Start cluster with automatic restarts and logging
+pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
+
+# Persist across system reboots
+pm2 save
+pm2 startup
+```
+
+---
+
+### Option 4: Docker & No-KVM Mode
+
+For environments without `/dev/kvm` hardware acceleration (cloud VPS, GitHub Codespaces, standard Docker):
+
+```bash
+# Start container using Docker Compose
+docker compose up -d --build
+```
+
+Or run standalone:
+```bash
+docker run -d \
+  --name vpanel-pro \
+  --restart unless-stopped \
+  -e NO_KVM=1 \
+  -p 3001:3001 \
+  -p 3002:3002 \
+  -p 25501-25600:25501-25600 \
+  -v $(pwd)/data:/app/data \
+  -v $(pwd)/vms:/app/vms \
+  nobita329/vpanel-pro
+```

+### DB Tables Full Schema
